name: AGENT_COMMISSION_OPTION_TYPE
description: This minor entity translates the agent commission option code into a description.  Examples: - Monthly payment - Separate check - Include with base pay

name: AMERICAN_EXERCISE_OPTION
description: A type of option that is exercisable at any time during the life of the option.

name: APPLICATION_INVESTMENT_DETAIL
description: This entity contains the investment products of the application  For each investment product, the attribute Application Detail Investment Pct specifies the percentage of the total available amount of money that should be used for this investment product.

name: ASIAN_OPTION
description: Asian options include European average price and average strike options.

name: ASIAN_OPTION_TYPE
description: A code for the type of Asian Option such as Average Price Option and Average Strike Option.

name: ASSET-BACKED_SECURITY_PRINCIPAL
description: This entity tracks the principal for an asset-backed security over time.

name: ASSET-BACKED_SECURITY_TYPE
description: A code for the type of asset-backed security such as mortgage-backed securities (MBS's), collateralized mortgage obligations (CMOs), and collateralized debt obligations (CDOs).

name: AVERAGE_PRICE_OPTION
description: An average price option is an option whose payoff is the difference between the strike price and the average price of the underlying asset during the averaging period.

name: AVERAGE_STRIKE_OPTION
description: An average strike option is an option whose strike price is set to the average price of the underlying asset at the end of the averaging period.

name: BANK_TRADE_BOOK_TYPE
description: A code that indicates which accounting "book" this agreement appears in.  Examples: - Banking book - Trading book (internal) - Equity investment (internal) - Neither (is not an accounting agreement)

name: BARRIER_OPTION_TYPE
description: A classification of a barrier option. The four main types of barrier options are: - Up-and-out: spot price starts below the barrier level and has to move up for the option to be knocked out. - Down-and-out: spot price starts above the barrier level and has to move down for the option to become null

name: BENEFIT_PLAN_OPTION
description: Captures the components of an organization's benefit plan. Generally, benefit plans are the parts of the total compensation package, other than for pay for time worked, provided to ASSOCIATEs in whole or in part by employer payments. Examples include life insurance, pension, and vacation.

name: BENEFIT_PLAN_OPTION_ELIGIBILITY
description: This entity captures eligibility terms associated with a position's benefit plan options. For example, eligibility for vacation time or profit-sharing benefits offered with a position may require a certain length of service.

name: BENEFIT_PLAN_OPTION_STATUS_TYPE
description: The status or conditions that can be assigned to a BENEFIT PLAN OPTION such as active, inactive, pending, or canceled.

name: BENEFIT_PLAN_OPTION_SUBTYPE
description: The entity that holds information about elective or discretionary parts of an employer's benefit plan offered to associates. Examples include medical insurance, life insurance, pension, and vacation. This is used as a subtype discriminator.

name: BERMUDA_EXERCISE_OPTION
description: A type of option that is exercisable at specified periods during the life of the option. In concept, it is between an American and a European option, where the analogy is the island of Bermuda is between Europe and America.

name: BEST_OF_OPTION
description: A put or call option on the best or worst return of two or more securities or indexes for a given measurement period.

name: BINARY_OPTION
description: A binary option is a type of option where the payoff is either some fixed amount of some asset or nothing at all. The two main types of binary options are the cash-or-nothing binary option and the asset-or-nothing binary option. The cash-or-nothing binary option pays some fixed amount of cash if the

name: BOND
description: A bond is a debt security, in which the authorized issuer owes the holders a debt and is obliged to repay the principal and interest (the coupon) at a later date, termed maturity. Other stipulations may also be attached to the bond issue, such as the obligation for the issuer to provide certain info

name: BOND_AMORTIZATION_SCHEDULE
description: A complete schedule of periodic blended loan payments, showing the amount of principal and the amount of interest that comprise each payment so that the loan will be paid off at the end of its term. Early in the schedule, the majority of each periodic payment is interest. Later in the schedule, the

name: BOND_CALL_SCHEDULE
description: A list specifying dates on which the issuer of the bond can call back the bond. The list includes dates and prices.

name: BOND_CALL_TYPE
description: Three types of call provisions are commonly encountered: - Optional redemption allows the issuer to call the security for any reason. - Extraordinary redemption primarily applies to bonds. It provides for redemption if certain specified events occur. One such event might be the destruction of facili

name: BOND_CONVERSION_SCHEDULE
description: List specifying the conversion ratio. This is the number of shares of stock the holder will receive for each unit of the notional principal in the bond. It is expressed as a ratio of number of stock shares to number of bond units.

name: BOND_CONVERSION_STYLE_TYPE
description: Convertibles can have American, European, or Bermuda conversion types.

name: BOND_DELIVERY_FORM_TYPE
description: Categorization of delivery forms.  Examples: - Book entry - Registered - Bearer

name: BOND_FIXED_INTEREST_RATE
description: A percentage of the face or principal amount that remains fixed over the entire investment period.

name: BOND_FLOATING_INTEREST_RATE
description: A bond interest type that is adjusted periodically based upon on a predefined formula, which is typically linked to an index.

name: BOND_FUTURES
description: A bond future is a contractual obligation for the contract holder to purchase or sell a bond on a specified date at a predetermined price. A bond future can be bought in a futures exchange market and the prices and dates are determined at the time the future is purchased.

name: BOND_INTEREST_PAY_AT_MATURITY
description: Bonds that have no periodic interest payments and the investor receives a single payment at maturity equal to the purchase price + interest earned, compounded semiannually at the original interest rate.  These are known as zero coupon bonds.

name: BOND_PUT_SCHEDULE
description: This is a list of dates on which the holder of the bond can sell it back to the issuer. The list includes dates and prices.

name: BOND_REDEMPTION
description: The return of an investor's principal in a fixed income security, such as a preferred stock or bond, or the sale of units in a mutual fund. Redemption occurs in a fixed income security at par or at a premium price upon maturity or cancelation by the issuer. With mutual funds, the time of the redempt

name: BOND_SUBTYPE
description: A code for the classification of the bond such as fixed rate bond, floating rate bond (FRN), high yield bond, zero coupon bond, inflation linked bond, indexed bond, equity linked note, subordinated bond, perpetual bond, bearer bond, registered bond, municipal bond, book-entry bond, lottery bond, and

name: BOND_TO_EQUITY_CONVERSION
description: Event involving conversion of a convertible bond from bond to equity.

name: CAP_AND_FLOOR_OPTION
description: Caps and floors are forms of option contracts, conferring potential benefits to the purchaser and potential obligations on the seller. When purchasing a cap or floor, the buyer pays a premium – typically up-front. The premium amount depends on the specified cap or floor rate and time period covered,

name: CASH_DIVIDEND_EVENT
description: This entity contains all dividends that are cash dividends.

name: CELL_TARGET_MARKET
description: This entity includes the geography designations included in a specific campaign cell. This structure would be especially useful for indirect marketing campaigns.

name: CHOOSER_OPTION
description: A chooser option (or preference option) is a path dependent option for which the purchaser pays an up-front premium and has the choice of having the derivative be a vanilla put or call on a given underlier. The investor has a fixed period of time to make that choice. There is usually a single strike

name: CLIQUET_OPTION
description: A Cliquet Option (also known as Ratchet Option) is an exotic option consisting of a series of consecutive forward start options. The first is active immediately. The second becomes active when the first expires. Each option is struck at-the-money when it becomes active.  A cliquet is, therefore, a s

name: COMMODITY_FUTURES
description: An agreement to buy or sell a set amount of a commodity at a predetermined price and date. Buyers use these to avoid the risks associated with the price fluctuations of the product or raw material, while sellers try to lock in a price for their products. Like in all financial markets, others use suc

name: COMMODITY_SWAP
description: A conventional swap agreement where the underlying is a commodity price.

name: CONTINGENT_OPTION
description: An option for which the holder only pays the premium if the option is exercised. Contingent options are zero-cost unless exercised.

name: CONVERTIBLE_BOND
description: A bond that can be converted into a predetermined amount of the company's equity at certain times during its life, usually at the discretion of the bondholder.

name: CORPORATE_BOND
description: A bond issued by a corporation.

name: CORPORATE_BOND_TYPE
description: Corporate bonds come in a variety of formats. Examples include collateral trust bonds, equipment trust certificates, debenture bonds, and guaranteed bonds.

name: COUPON_TYPE
description: Indicates the type of coupon.  Examples: - Price discount - Free product - Other

name: CURRENCY_EXCHANGE_QUOTATION
description: This is a subtype to quotation and contains quotes for currency exchange such as the offered rate and fee that may apply.

name: CURRENCY_FORWARD
description: A forward contract in the foreign exchange market that locks in the price at which an entity can buy or sell a currency on a future date. Also known as "outright forward currency transaction," "forward outright," or "FX forward."

name: CURRENCY_SWAP
description: This entity is for currency swap agreements only and contains information about the currency being swapped.

name: CURRENCY_SWAP_TYPE
description: This is a code for the type of currency swap. Below are examples from MiFID II: - FXCR = foreign exchange cross rates - FXEM = foreign exchange emerging markets - FXMJ = foreign exchange majors

name: DERIVATIVE_NOTIONAL_CHANGE_TYPE
description: This indicates whether the transaction is an increase or decrease of notional of a derivative contract. This field only applies when there is a change in notional for a derivative contract. This is a MiFID II requirement for field number 32.  Possible values: - "INCR" = increase - "DECR" = decrease

name: DERIVATIVE_SUBTYPE
description: This is a classification for the type of derivative such as future (exchange traded), option (puts and calls), forwards (not exchange traded), caps/floors, and swaptions (option of a swap).

name: DESIGNATED_MARKET_AREA__GEO
description: * USA centric – replace with appropriate localized content as needed.  Designated Market Area is a Nielsen trademarked demographic grouping mainly used for television audience measure that is geographically based.  In 2008, it contained 209 distinct groupings of USA counties defining television audi

name: DIFFERENTIAL_SWAP
description: A differential swap is a swap with two floating legs.

name: DIVIDEND_DECLARE_EVENT
description: This entity contains all investment product events that are declarations of dividend. The date/time in EVENT is the date/time of the declaration of the dividend. The record date, ex- dividend date and the payable date are attributes in this entity. These details can vary by market exchange for each

name: DIVIDEND_TYPE
description: This is a code for the form of dividend such as: - Cash dividend - Stock dividend - Property

name: EQUITY_FUTURES
description: A futures contract on a stock or financial index. For each index, there may be a different multiple for determining the price of the futures contract.

name: EQUITY_FUTURES_DIVIDEND_SCHEDULE
description: List specifying the expected dividends during life of futures contract.

name: EQUITY_HOLDING_SUMMARY
description: This entity tracks various metrics related to the equity holdings of the Bank or a subsidiary. It is intended to support Basel II market disclosure requirements (Pillar 3), specifically Table 12.

name: EUROCURRENCY_FUTURES
description: This is a type of futures contract that deals with futures in the Euro currency.

name: EUROPEAN_EXERCISE_OPTION
description: A type of option that is exercisable only at the expiration of the option.

name: EXTERNAL_COUPON
description: An external (third-party) (manufacturer's or competitor's) coupon redeemed during a purchase.  Note: A unique coupon may be received and used by many customers (say a coupon in a box of cereal). For purposes of the identification, all of these identical coupons are given the same, unique External Co

name: FIXED_FIXED_INTEREST_RATE_SWAP
description: This is a type of interest rate swap where a fixed interest rate is exchanged for another fixed interest rate.  Example: - Party P pays/receives fixed interest in currency A to receive/pay fixed rate in currency B for a term of T years. For example, you pay JPY 1.6% on a JPY notional of 1.2 billion

name: FIXED_FLOATING_INTEREST_RATE_SWAP
description: An interest rate swap where a fixed interest rate is exchanged for a floating interest rate.  Fixed-for-floating swaps in same currency are used to convert a fixed rate asset/liability to a floating rate asset/liability or vice versa. For example, if a company has a fixed rate USD 10 million loan at

name: FLOAT_FLOAT_INTEREST_RATE_SWAP
description: This is a type of interest rate swap where a floating interest rate is exchanged for a fixed interest rate.

name: FORWARD_START_OPTION
description: A forward start option is an option that commences at some specified future date with an expiration date further in the future. It is essentially a forward on an option, only the premium is paid in advance. Since the asset price at the start of this option is not known a priori, it is common to spec

name: FORWARD_SUBTYPE
description: This minor entity describes if this is a currency type of forward contract.

name: FUND
description: A mutual fund is a form of collective investments that pools money from many investors and invests their money in stocks, bonds, short-term money market instruments, and/or other securities.  In a mutual fund, the fund manager who is also known as the portfolio manager, trades the fund's underlying

name: FUNDING_AMOUNT_TYPE
description: A code for the type of amount being funded such as deposit, loan down payment, and capital markets buy order.

name: FUND_SOURCE_TYPE
description: The unique code for the type of source that provided the funds or agreement for the account such as cash, other bank's check, transferred from an existing account, and refinance.

name: FUND_TYPE
description: A code for the classification of funds such as equity fund, mid cap fund, large cap fund, growth fund, value fund, index fund, bond fund, money market fund, hedge fund, fund of funds, balanced fund, clone fund, capital appreciation fund, and crossover fund.

name: INSURANCE_QUOTATION
description: This is a subtype to QUOTATION and contains those quotations that are for insurance.

name: INTEREST_RATE_QUOTATION
description: This entity contains market quotes for interest rates such as Treasurys or money market based on a term for a given currency.

name: INTEREST_RATE_SWAP
description: An interest rate swap is an agreement to exchange net future cash flows. In fixed for floating swaps, one counterparty pays a fixed rate and the other pays a floating rate based on a reference rate such as Libor. There is no exchange of principal. The interest payments are made on a notional amount.

name: INTEREST_RATE_SWAP_SUBTYPE
description: A classification of an interest rate swap as either a fixed-fixed interest rate swap, a fixed-floating interest rate swap, or a floating-floating interest rate swap.

name: INVESTMENT_CORPORATE_ACTION
description: This entity contains all externally originated events that are related to an investment product. These events are usually initiated by the investment product issuer or by an exchange and are referred to as "corporate actions."  Examples are: - Declaration of dividend - Distribution of units, such as

name: INVESTMENT_COST_BASIS
description: This tracks the cost basis for this investment over time.  The cost basis of any investment is the original value of an asset adjusted for stock splits, dividends and capital distributions. It is used to calculate the capital gain or loss on an investment for tax purposes. The original value may be

name: INVESTMENT_COST_BASIS_CHANGE_REASON
description: This is a code for the reason the cost basis changed such as correction, corporate action, or original value.

name: INVESTMENT_EVENT_SUBTYPE
description: This minor entity translates the code for the type of investment event that affects positions into a description. Used as a category discriminator.  Examples are: - 1 = financial settlement of trade, fee, cost, commission, and tax - 2 = trade order - 3 = trade execution - 4 = transfer to/from anothe

name: INVESTMENT_GRADE_PARAMETER
description: This entity will identify whether a class of industries with a give risk grade are considered investment grade.  An investment grade security is an investment instrument, other than an insurance policy or fixed annuity, which offers evidence of debt or equity and is issued by an organization that ha

name: INVESTMENT_HOLDING
description: This entity keeps track of the number of units for the investment products (holdings) that are outside of a portfolio. These investments may include your institution's investments or your customer's investments where you are a party to the investment. There is one instance for each homogenous holdin

name: INVESTMENT_OBJECTIVE_TYPE
description: A code for the type of investment objective such as capital appreciation or income.

name: INVESTMENT_SERVICE
description: This type of product is an investment service such as financial analysis or brokerage service. It does not include the financial instruments.  For investment banking, examples of services include investment banking advisory services like mergers and acquisition advice and capital raising advice, and

name: INVESTMENT_SERVICE_SUBTYPE
description: A classification of the type of investment service offered such as: - Brokerage service - Financial analysis service - Investment portfolio management - Merger and acquisition service - Investment underwriting service

name: INVESTMENT_SUBTYPE
description: Used as a subtype discriminator to distinguish the types of investments such as: - Foreign exchange (e.g., nostra accounts) - Securities finance (including repos) - Derivative - Cash at other banks - Security holding  Note that credit derivatives are a subtype to RISK MITIGANT AGREEMENT.

name: INVESTMENT_VALUE_TYPE
description: This is a code for the type of value or metric of the investment.  Examples of types of values include: - Fair market value - Fair value or book value as presented on balance sheet – internal investment - Actual return – internal investments - Predicted return – internal investments - Cost basis

name: ISO_10383_MARKET_IDENTIFIER_CODE

name: ISO_10383_MARKET_IDENTIFIER_CODE_STATUS
description: This is a code for the status of the Market Identifier Code such as active, inactive, or pending approval.

name: LIFE_LINE_QUOTATION
description: This is a subtype to INSURANCE QUOTATION and contains the details of those quotations that are for the line of life insurance.

name: LOOKBACK_OPTION
description: An exotic option that allows investors to "look back" at the underlying prices occurring over the life of the option, and then exercise based on the underlying asset's optimal value.

name: MARKETING_GOAL_TYPE
description: A code for the commercial marketing target such as expand portfolio or retain portfolio.

name: MARKETING_SUPPORT_TYPE
description: A code for the type of marketing support that the insurance company provides its agent to market themselves such as brochures, gifts to give their customers, advertisements, and mailings.

name: MARKET_INDEX
description: This entity tracks the value of a collection of stocks or other securities over time such as the U.S. Dow Jones 30 Industrial, the FTSE 500, and Tokyo Nikkei 300.  The index is usually published by a party, such as the Wall Street Journal publishes the Dow Jones Industrial Average index of 30 indust

name: MARKET_INDEX_VALUE
description: The closing price for this index. The value of the index may be an average expressed relative to a predetermined market value. The algorithm for the computation of the index value differs from one index to another.

name: MARKET_PARTICIPANT_PARAMETER
description: This table is a list of market participant types and parameters as listed in the Basel Accord.  Market participant types as listed in the Basel Accord: - Corporate - Bank - Sovereign - Small medium enterprise (SME) corporate - Small medium enterprise (SME) retail - Retail

name: MARKET_PLAN
description: This entity contains market and planning information when first creating a market strategy for a product. Some of the information in this entity is based on market research. description: This entity contains the value of the investment product, in a specified currency, at a specified date and time, at a specified stock exchange, and as reported by a party (such as Reuters). If the time is 24:00, the value represents the final value of that day.  This is the market feed or market quo

name: MARKET_QUOTATION_METRIC
description: This entity contains the various metrics that are reported about this investment product at a point-in-time.  Examples of metrics include: - Last bid price - Last ask price - Earnings per share - Average earnings per share - Average earnings per share four weeks ago - Beta (correlation with benchmar

name: MARKET_QUOTATION_METRIC_TYPE
description: A code for the type of metric that is reported by the information reporting company such as Reuters or Bloomberg. The metrics can vary. name: MARKET_QUOTATION_TIME_PERIOD_METRIC
description: This entity contains the market feeds that report metrics about an instrument (e.g., stock, bond, or their derivative) over a period of time. It gives information such as high and low for the day, and high and low for a time period (e.g., 52 week high and low).  The metrics reported can vary by repo

name: MARKET_SEGMENT
description: A grouping of parties for marketing or analysis purposes. A market segment can be reused, can receive multiple offers, serve as a control group, or be used for customer and product analysis purposes.  A market segment is different from a party group in that a market segment is created from an intern

name: MARKET_SEGMENT_GROUP
description: Allows related market segments to be grouped together.  Example: - To segment top spenders into 10 segments, these 10 segments can now all be grouped together by relating them to the same MARKET SEGMENT GROUP, for example, "Top spenders by decile."

name: MARKET_SEGMENT_SCHEME
description: This entity describes the method for segmentation such as income, location, or age. A scheme can result in many segments.

name: MARK_TO_MARKET
description: Mark to market is the updating of the value of a financial product position based on market data, and depending on the financial product, a valuation model.  The position that is updated is the agreement found in AGREEMENT EVENT.

name: MENU_OPTION_TYPE
description: This minor entity translates the calling option to a description. This entity would only be used during a session with a Voice Response Unit or other automatic device that directs the customer through a series of options before they get to the one they want.

name: MUNICIPAL_BOND
description: A debt security issued by a state, municipality, or county to finance its capital expenditures. Municipal bonds are exempt from federal taxes and from most state and local taxes, especially if you live in the state in which the bond is issued.

name: OPTION_EXERCISE
description: Discretionary exercise of a long call/put option by the owner.

name: OPTION_EXERCISE_TYPE
description: The exercise dates define when the option can be exercised. There are three main excise styles: American, European, and Bermudan.

name: OPTION_PUT_CALL_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes whether this option is a put or a call type of option.  A put option gives the holder the right but not the obligation to sell the underlying instrument for a specified period of time at a specified price (strike price). Puts are bought by investors who believe the price

name: OPTION_STYLE_SUBTYPE
description: A code that classifies the type of option based on its family or style.  In finance, the style or family of an option is a general term denoting the class into which the option falls, usually defined by the dates on which the option may be exercised. The vast majority of options are either European

name: OVERNIGHT_INDEX_SWAP
description: An overnight index swap is an interest rate swap involving the overnight rate being exchanged for some fixed interest rate. Generally short-term, the interest of the overnight rate portion of the swap is compounded and paid at maturity.

name: PORTFOLIO
description: A portfolio, from the perspective of the financial institution as a broker/dealer, has a specific operational meaning. name: PORTFOLIO_INVESTMENT_ALLOCATION
description: This entity keeps track of investment allocation objectives for this investment portfolio. It varies by asset class or product group such as stock, bonds, and cash.

name: PORTFOLIO_METRIC_TYPE
description: This entity classifies the types of metrics for investment product amount, such as interest earned, and dividends earned.

name: PRIVATE_INVESTMENT_FUND_MANAGER
description: The management of private investment funds that include mutual funds, hedge funds, and venture funds. Private investment funds gather capital from individuals and organizations and invest it on their behalf.

name: QUOTATION
description: This entity contains information about a quotation made by the financial institution to one or more parties involving a specific product.

name: QUOTATION_ASSET
description: This associative entity relates a quotation to an asset along with the role that the asset has with the quotation. An example of a role of an asset to a quotation is a collateral role.

name: QUOTATION_ASSET_ROLE_SUBTYPE
description: This code contains the role of the asset to the quotation and is used as a subtype code. Roles can include is collateral for, is insured asset for, or is subject of a lease.

name: QUOTATION_CLOSE_REASON_TYPE
description: This minor entity converts the quotation close reason code into a description.

name: QUOTATION_EVENT
description: This entity is a subtype to EVENT and contains those contacts that involve a quotation made by the financial institution.

name: QUOTATION_INSURED_ASSET
description: This is a subtype to entity QUOTATION ASSET and contains details of the asset in relation to the quotation in the role of to be insured.

name: QUOTATION_METRIC
description: This entity contains the various metrics that are associated with a quotation such as the premium amount for an insurance quotation.

name: QUOTATION_METRIC_TYPE
description: This is a code for the type of metric such as annual premium for an insurance quotation.

name: QUOTATION_ORIGIN_TYPE
description: This minor entity converts the origin for quotation code into a description.

name: QUOTATION_RELATED
description: This entity tracks the relationships between quotations, such as one quotation replacing another quotation, or quotations having been submitted together.

name: QUOTATION_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE
description: This minor entity converts the quotation relationship code into a description.

name: QUOTATION_STATUS
description: This entity tracks the history of the status of a quotation.

name: QUOTATION_STATUS_REASON
description: This associative entity allows one or more status reasons to be valid for one quotation status.

name: QUOTATION_STATUS_REASON_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the reasons for the status of a quotation.  Examples: - New quotation requested - Too highly priced

name: QUOTATION_STATUS_TYPE
description: This minor entity converts the quotation status type code into a description.

name: QUOTATION_SUBTYPE
description: A classification of the quotation such as the major line of business or product being quoted, and which is used as a subtype category discriminator such as insurance quotation or foreign exchange quotation.

name: REAL_ESTATE_INVESTMENT_TRUST
description: A security that sells like a stock on the major exchanges and invests in real estate directly, either through properties or mortgages.

name: REGULATORY_INVESTMENT_TYPE
description: A classification of the regulatory support of the equity holdings, for example, under legislated programs, equity participation, and equity in well-diversified portfolio.

name: REIT_DIVIDEND_SCHEDULE
description: Dividends schedule for REIT.

name: SALES_MARKET
description: This entity captures information regarding a market that is based on geography. This area is defined by the business can be as large as North America, Europe, or Asia. description: This entity captures information regarding the various activities that a salesperson performs.  Examples: - Tasks - Events - Email messages - Appointments - Phone calls

name: SALES_MARKETING_ACTIVITY_RELATED
description: This entity captures information regarding the relationship between sales activities.

name: SALES_MARKETING_ACTIVITY_RELATED_ROLE
description: This entity captures information regarding the relationship of one sales marketing activity to another sales marketing activity. This role code can represent both sides of the relationship.

name: SALES_MARKETING_ACTIVITY_RELATED_STATUS
description: This entity tracks the history of status changes for the relationship between sales marketing activities.

name: SALES_MARKETING_ACTIVITY_RELATED_STATUS_REASON
description: This entity captures information regarding the reason why a particular sales marketing activity status type may be assigned to a sales marketing activity relationship.

name: SALES_MARKETING_ACTIVITY_RELATED_STATUS_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding the classifications tracked to the relationship role for a sales marketing activity.  Examples: - Active - Inactive - Prospective - Unmarketable customer (i.e., deceased)

name: SALES_MARKETING_ACTIVITY_STATUS
description: This entity captures information regarding the status of a sales activity over time.

name: SALES_MARKETING_ACTIVITY_STATUS_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding the type of statuses a sales marketing activity may have.  Examples: - Open - Completed

name: SALES_MARKETING_ACTIVITY_TEXT_COMMENT
description: This entity captures information regarding textual notes concerning a sales marketing activity.

name: SECONDARY_MARKET_STATUS_TYPE
description: A code that describes the status of this asset in the secondary market and your involvement with the buy or sale of this asset. name: SECURITY_ASSET
description: This entity contains information about issuances of specific security instruments, which could include the actual certificate number range. Security certificates may be pledged as collateral or part of a collateral agreement.

name: SECURITY_TYPE
description: This minor entity indicates whether this loan (including credit cards and current accounts) has any kind of collateral or third-party guarantee or other risk mitigant that will compensate your institution if the obligor defaults.  Examples: - Collateral - Third-party guarantee - Credit derivative

name: SHOUT_OPTION
description: A shout option is an exotic option that allows the holder to lock in a defined profit while maintaining the right to continue participating in gains without a loss of locked in monies. name: SINKING_FUND_SCHEDULE
description: List of dates and prices when the issuer can redeem outstanding bonds.

name: SOVEREIGN_WEALTH_FUND_MANAGER
description: The management of pools of money derived from a country's reserves, which are set aside for investment purposes that will benefit the country's economy and citizens. The funding for a Sovereign Wealth Fund (SWF) comes from central bank reserves that accumulate as a result of budget and trade surplus

name: STOCK_BOND_HOLDING
description: This entity represents holdings in securities such as stocks, bonds, or funds that are not part of a brokerage portfolio. It does not include derivative or swap agreements. This would include holdings by your financial institution or holdings by other parties outside of a portfolio.

name: STOCK_DIVIDEND_EVENT
description: This entity contains all dividends that are stock dividends.

name: SWAP_DIRECTION_TYPE
description: This reference entity is the code indicates whether the direction of the swap payment is outbound (from your institution to an outside party) or inbound (from outside party to your institution).  Examples: - Inbound - Outbound

name: SWAP_LEG_AMORTIZATION_SCHEDULE
description: The schedule of dates on which the swap's underlying principal declines by a predefined amount. Each date on the schedule has a corresponding amount.

name: SWAP_LEG_CALL_SCHEDULE
description: The schedule of dates on which the swap may be called back with corresponding strike prices.

name: SWAP_LEG_PROJECTED_CASH_FLOW
description: This entity contains the results of a projection of the cash flow for this swap leg.

name: SWAP_LEG_RESET_SCHEDULE
description: A schedule of dates when recalculations are made to determine the amount of payments.

name: SWAP_LEG_TYPE
description: A classification of the type of leg for a swap.  Examples of types of legs can be flat, amortizing, zero coupon, and capped/floored.

name: SWAP_METRIC_TYPE
description: This entity identifies the types of metrics that could be tracked for a swap leg such as exposure and duration. This can contain any calculated metric at the swap leg level.

name: SWAP_OBLIGATION_SUBTYPE
description: A classification of the type of swap such as: - Interest rate swap    o Coupon swap – fixed for floating in same currency    o Basis swap –- floating for floating in same currency    o Cross-currency swap – fixed rate in one currency for floating rate in another - Currency swap - Bond swap - Commodi

name: SWAP_OPTION
description: A swap option is an option to enter into an interest rate swap. In exchange for an option premium, the buyer gains the right but not the obligation to enter into a specified swap agreement with the issuer on a specified future date. name: TOTAL_RATE_OF_RETURN_SWAP
description: A total rate of return swap is a derivative that simulates the purchase of an instrument (e.g., note, bond, or equity) with 100% financing, which is typically floating rate. name: TRADE_CANCEL_TYPE
description: This conde indicates whether this trade is a new trade or a cancelation of an existing trade order.  Values per MiFID/MiFIR: - NEWT = new trade - CANC = cancelation of an existing trade.

name: TRADE_EVENT_SETTLE_INSTRUCTION
description: This entity contains only those instructions at the trade execution level.

name: TRADE_EXECUTION
description: This entity contains additional information about the execution of a trade where your firm is operationally involved as the buyer, the seller, or the agent to the trade. Settlements (the actual exchange of money and shares/units) for this trade execution are handled in another entity.

name: TRADE_EXECUTION_STATUS_TYPE
description: This entity has codes for the trade confirmation status such as:  Examples: - Issued - Confirmed - Not confirmed

name: TRADE_EXECUTION_WAIVER
description: This entity associates the trade execution with the waiver type. There can be one or more waiver types for a given trade execution.

name: TRADE_EXECUTION_WAIVER_TYPE
description: This is a code that indicates whether the transaction was executed under a pretrade waiver. This field is only populated for the market side of a transaction executed under a waiver on a trading venue. This is MiFID field 61. Possible values include: For all instruments: - LRGS = large in scale  For

name: TRADE_METHOD_TYPE
description: Counterparties have trade order confirmation transmission preferences including the following: - Swift - Email - Fax

name: TRADE_ORDER
description: This entity tracks all events related to investment trade orders. This includes all events related to the order including creating the order, modifying the order, filling the order, and canceling the order.

name: TRADE_ORDER_BUY_SELL_TYPE
description: This minor entity translates the code for the category of order into a description. This complies with MiFID field 62.  Examples: - Buy - Sell long - Sell short with no exemption - Sell short with exemption - Information not available

name: TRADE_ORDER_EVENT_TYPE
description: This classifies the trade order event as either a new order, an order modification, a cancelation, a rejection, partial fill or fill exception. The codes are per the MiFID II requirements. The code value would be one of the following for each event related to the order.  Examples: - NEWO = new order

name: TRADE_ORDER_INVESTMENT_DECIDER_TYPE
description: This is a code for whether the investment decision was made by a person or by a model algorithm as required for MiFID II or by neither.

name: TRADE_ORDER_PHASE_TYPE
description: This is a code for the trading phase that an order is present according to the trading venue order book. Possible values include trading halt, circuit breaker and suspension.

name: TRADE_ORDER_PRICE_NOTATION_TYPE
description: This is a code for how the price is expressed as an amount, percent or yield rate. Possible values are: - "MONE" = monetary amount - "PERC" = percent - "YIEL" = yield

name: TRADE_ORDER_RESTRICTION
description: This entity identifies trade order restrictions such as valid for auction, good for closing price crossing session, valid for continuous trading only and other. A trade order can have more than one restriction. This is needed for MiFID II compliance.

name: TRADE_ORDER_RESTRICTION_TYPE
description: This is a code for restrictions for a trade order as required for MiFID II.  Example values are: - SESR – Good for closing price crossing session. name: TRADE_ORDER_STATUS
description: This entity tracks the status of a trade order:  Examples: - Trade orders can have the following status: - Settled - Fail to receive - Fail to deliver - Partial delivery - Filled - Open  Status values per MiFID II include: - Active - Inactive - Firm quote - Indicative quote - Routed order

name: TRADE_ORDER_STATUS_TYPE
description: This contains the codes for trade order status such as: - Settled - Fail to receive - Fail to deliver - Partial delivery - Filled - Open  Status values per MiFID II include: - Active - Inactive - Firm quote - Indicative quote - Routed order

name: TRADE_ORDER_TYPE
description: The code for the type of trade order.  Examples: - 1 = Stop order - 2 = Stop limit - 3 = Fill or Kill (FOK) - 4 = Immediate or Cancel (IOC) - 5 = All or None (AON) - 6 = Spread order - 7 = Straddle order - 8 = Combination order - 9 = One Cancels Other (OCO) - 10 = Market order - 11 = Pegged limit or

name: TRADE_ORDER_VENUE_PRIORITY
description: This entity contains information about the trade order that would be supplied by the trading venue such as the exchange such as order book code and priority numbers.

name: TRADE_ORDER_VENUE_TYPE
description: This is a classification of the order according to the classification system of the trading venue.

name: TRADE_SETTLE_BOOK_DELIVERY
description: This entity contains settlement instruction information when the security is electronically (book) delivered to the destination through a depository.

name: TRADE_SETTLE_FOREIGN_DELIVERY
description: This entity contains settlement instruction information when the delivery type is foreign local where securities are traded on a foreign exchange and settled in the local currency and by a local settlement agent.

name: TRADE_SETTLE_PHYSICAL_DELIVERY
description: This entity contains settlement instruction information when the product is physically delivered to the destination.

name: TREASURY_BOND_SUBTYPE
description: A classification of a U.S. Treasury bond in to inflation protected and not inflation protected.

name: U.S._TREASURY_BOND
description: Treasury bills, notes, and bonds are marketable securities the U.S. government sells in order to pay off maturing debt and raise the cash needed to run the federal government. name: UNSETTLED_TRADE_PARAMETER
description: This table is used to lookup the risk multiplier for calculating the capital charge for non-DvP (delivery versus payment) transaction.  Reference Annex 3 of the Nov 2005 Accord. name: WHISPER_OPTION
description: A whisper option gives the owner the right to fix the strike price of an option at any time during the life of the option. name: YIELD_CURVE_MATURITY_SEGMENT_TYPE
description: For market risk calculation for interest rates using the internal model's approach, the yield curve is divided into maturity segments to capture the volatility of rates along the yield curve.  Example of a segment is LIBOR 1-10 years.

name: YIELD_TO_MATURITY_PARAMETER
description: This entity contains the yield to maturity for an instrument type (e.g., zero coupon bonds).

name: Z_BOND
description: Z-bonds are tranches where the bond coupon is accrued by adding the interest to the face value of the bond. The interest that normally would be paid to the parent bond during the lockout period is deferred and added to the Z-bond's principal value in a process called accretion.
